SELECT * FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_PROCESS
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalProcesses, SUM(CASE WHEN COMPILATION_STATUS IN ('进行中', 'in_progress', 'IN_PROGRESS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inProgressProcesses, SUM(CASE WHEN COMPILATION_STATUS IN ('已完成', 'completed', 'COMPLETED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedProcesses, SUM(CASE WHEN COMPILATION_STATUS IN ('已暂停', 'paused', 'PAUSED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pausedProcesses, SUM(CASE WHEN AUDIT_STATUS IN ('待审核', 'pending_audit', 'PENDING_AUDIT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingAuditProcesses, SUM(CASE WHEN AUDIT_STATUS IN ('审核中', 'auditing', 'AUDITING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as auditingProcesses, SUM(CASE WHEN AUDIT_STATUS IN ('审核通过', '终审通过', 'approved', 'APPROVED', 'final_audit_passed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approvedProcesses, SUM(CASE WHEN AUDIT_STATUS IN ('审核不通过', 'rejected', 'REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rejectedProcesses, AVG(COMPILATION_PROGRESS) as avgCompilationProgress, AVG(DATA_COLLECTION_PROGRESS) as avgDataCollectionProgress, AVG(AUDIT_PROGRESS) as avgAuditProgress, AVG(DATA_QUALITY_SCORE) as avgDataQualityScore, COALESCE(AVG(OVERALL_QUALITY_SCORE), 0) as avgOverallQualityScore, COALESCE(SUM(ISSUE_COUNT), 0) as totalIssueCount, COALESCE(SUM(CRITICAL_ISSUE_COUNT), 0) as totalCriticalIssueCount FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_PROCESS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT STATEMENT_TYPE as statementType, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_PROCESS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'), 2) as percentage FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_PROCESS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY STATEMENT_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COMPILATION_STATUS as compilationStatus, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_PROCESS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'), 2) as percentage FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_PROCESS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY COMPILATION_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT AUDIT_STATUS as auditStatus, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_PROCESS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'), 2) as percentage FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_PROCESS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY AUDIT_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN OVERALL_QUALITY_SCORE >= 90 THEN '优秀(90-100)' WHEN OVERALL_QUALITY_SCORE >= 80 THEN '良好(80-89)' WHEN OVERALL_QUALITY_SCORE >= 70 THEN '一般(70-79)' WHEN OVERALL_QUALITY_SCORE >= 60 THEN '及格(60-69)' ELSE '不及格(0-59)' END as scoreRange, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_PROCESS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND OVERALL_QUALITY_SCORE IS NOT NULL), 2) as percentage FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_PROCESS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND OVERALL_QUALITY_SCORE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN OVERALL_QUALITY_SCORE >= 90 THEN '优秀(90-100)' WHEN OVERALL_QUALITY_SCORE >= 80 THEN '良好(80-89)' WHEN OVERALL_QUALITY_SCORE >= 70 THEN '一般(70-79)' WHEN OVERALL_QUALITY_SCORE >= 60 THEN '及格(60-69)' ELSE '不及格(0-59)' END ORDER BY count DESC
